title: New York buyer loses $1 million lawsuit after demanding $270,000 cut on $550,000 Bronx home deal
summary_full: A man from New York made a cash offer for a dilapidated home in the Bronx, agreeing to accept it in its current state. After finding additional issues just days before the closing, he sought a considerable price decrease. The seller declined, referring to the contract terms and previous property condition disclosures.
